description: Source code for the RequestHandler class in the LifecycleManager component, managing initialization, termination, and state transitions for application lifecycle management within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle requests, including initialization, termination, launching, and intent handling within the plugin.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes runtime and window managers, and sets up event handling.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates runtime and window managers.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Updates the application state to a target lifecycle state.

methods.name: terminate (overloaded)
methods.description: Updates the application state to TERMINATING.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sets the most recent intent in the application context.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Creates and adds a state transition request to the handler.

methods.name: getRuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the runtime manager handler instance.

methods.name: getWindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the window manager handler instance.
